text:
nate: Quick onboarding q from week 1  who owns what for: VPC peering, private deploy approvals, rollout canaries, and emergency pages? Trying to make a tiny cheat-sheet.

priya: Hi Nate! short version: eng-infra = network & creds (VPC peering); eng-platform = private deploy workflow and gating; eng-runtime = rollout tooling + canary infra; eng-sre = on-call for incidents.

zoe: For approvals: product signs off on model policy/QA, but platform approves infra gating bits. If you need a human approver for a canary, tag the feature PM + @product.

maria: onboarding tip: people-ops does initial IAM and baseline cloud access. After that, ping eng-infra for peering/VPC and eng-platform for deploy permissions. I'll add you to the "who-to-ping" sheet.

infra-bot: Note: eng-infra office hours Mon/Wed 14:00-15:00 PT. For urgent peering requests file ticket with label "vpc-urgent".

priya: Escalation sketch:
P1 (service down): page #eng-oncall + @eng-sre + @eng-runtime + product-lead
P2 (canary fail w/ rollback possible): page @eng-runtime and open incident ticket
P3 (non-urgent rollout tweak): open ops ticket, tag runtime + product

nate: awesome this helps a lot. Any specific people to ping for rapid approvals?

zoe: eng-infra leads: Sam K & Priya. runtime lead is Alex R. product lead varies by feature, but tag me if unsure and I'll point you to the PM.

maria: I'll DM the sheet link and add you to runbook access. Also there's a short Slack thread template we use for P1 pages (copy/pasteable)  ping me if you want it.

nate: thanks team! adding to my notes and will reach out if blocked :thumbsup:
